proposal.summary: User reports the desktop client occasionally sends requests to an unfamiliar address on startup and is unsure whether personal data is included.

AV.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up

PR.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the reporter to provide (1) the client name and exact version, (2) the full URL or IP address observed, (3) network logs or a packet capture of the startup traffic (or at minimum HTTP request lines/headers), and (4) a brief description of whether the client was configured with an account or credentials at the time.
